QUOTE: I did not find any other retry loop in `app/client` or the network manager. The only other retry logic there is the WebSocket reconnect backoff, which is unrelated to posts.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says posts use `noRetry: true` with `retryLimit: 0`, but it never says requests in general retry with exponential backoff and a limit of 3 set by the network manager.
